STRAT_DESCRIPTION: Sandstone, red, purple, slumped, silty. Some shale.
Sandstone, coarse-grained, bimodal, with large-scale crossbedding, sand grains very well rounded, spherical.
Granite to granodiorite gneiss, megacrystic; hypersthene granodiorite to charnockite; quartz gabbronorite; dykes of hornblende and alkali-feldspar granite and metadolerite. I-type, 1860-1841 Ma.
